keyword: what is the goal of artemis 2

verifications.claim: Artemis II is a 10-day, crewed flight test.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The 10-day Artemis II mission" (R5); "expected to last about 10 days" (R2, R6, R9, R10); "9 days, 1 hour, 32 minutes" approx 10 days (R3, R4); crewed test flight
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly describe it as a ~10-day crewed test flight.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is designed to validate NASA's Orion spacecraft in deep space.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "testing the Orion spacecraft" (R1); "validate the Orion spacecraft's systems" (R3); "test flight of... the Orion spacecraft" (R5); "validate... Orion spacecraft in deep space" (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Directly supported by sources specifying Orion validation in deep space.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is designed to validate SLS rocket in deep space.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "first crewed flight of the Space Launch System (SLS)" (R3); "test flight of... the SLS rocket" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: SLS is tested during launch/ascent, not in deep space (expended early); claim misattributes deep space validation to SLS.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is designed to validate life-support systems in deep space.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "check that the spacecraft can safely make the journey and keep its crew alive" (R2); "test essential life support systems" (R3); "flight test Orion’s life-support systems with astronauts" (R5); "validate the life-support... in deep space" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly stated in multiple sources.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is the first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "first crewed trip around the moon in more than 50 years" (R1); "first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit since Apollo 17 in 1972" (R3); similar in R2, R5, R6
verifications.reasoning: Consistently described as first crewed lunar mission in 50+ years.

verifications.claim: Artemis II aims to fly four astronauts around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "send four astronauts aboard the Orion spacecraft" around moon (R1); "four astronauts toward... around the moon" (R2); crew size 4, lunar flyby (all)
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm four astronauts on lunar flyby.

verifications.claim: Artemis II tests systems for future lunar landings.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "test flight supporting subsequent Artemis missions aimed at returning humans to the lunar surface" (R3); "lay the foundation... for Artemis III, which aims to return astronauts to the lunar surface" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Directly prepares for lunar landing missions like Artemis III.

verifications.claim: Artemis II tests systems for eventual Mars missions.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "preparing for deeper space exploration... put human feet on Mars" (R1); program context to Mars
verifications.reasoning: Broader Artemis program aims at Mars via lunar base, but Artemis II specifically tests for lunar/Moon missions, not directly Mars.

verifications.claim: Artemis II tests the Orion spacecraft's life-support systems with a crew on board.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "test essential life support systems aboard the spacecraft" with crew (R3); "flight test Orion’s life-support systems with astronauts on board" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Precisely matches descriptions.

verifications.claim: Artemis II tests the Orion spacecraft's environmental control systems with a crew on board.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "life support systems" includes environmental control (R3); life-support systems (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Environmental control is part of life-support (ECLSS), but not explicitly named; broader term used.

verifications.claim: Artemis II tests the Orion spacecraft's navigation systems with a crew on board.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "performed a series of maneuvers to evaluate handling qualities... using onboard navigation sensors" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Explicit testing of navigation sensors and manual control.

verifications.claim: Artemis II sends four astronauts on a journey around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "send four astronauts... around the moon" (R1); lunar flyby with four (all)
verifications.reasoning: Standard description across sources.

verifications.claim: Artemis II passes roughly 4,700 miles beyond the Moon.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "about 4,000 miles above the surface" (R2); "4,067 mi" (R3); "over 4,000 miles beyond the Moon" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources specify ~4,000-4,100 miles closest approach; 4,700 mismatches.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II astronauts include the first woman to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Ms. Koch... will be the first woman to do so" [deep space] (R2); "Christina Koch the first woman" beyond LEO (R3, R5)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly stated for Koch.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II astronauts include the first person of color to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Mr. Glover... first Black man to venture into deep space" / person of color (R2); "Victor Glover (an African-American) became the first person of color" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Glover identified as first person of color/Black in deep space.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II astronauts include the first Canadian to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Mr. Hansen... first person on a moon mission who is not an American" / first Canadian (R2); "Jeremy Hansen the first non-U.S. citizen" beyond LEO (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Hansen as first Canadian deep space.

verifications.claim: Artemis II aims to fly humans farther into space than ever before.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "set a distance record for the farthest that any humans have traveled from Earth: 252,799 miles" (R2); "set the record for human distance from Earth" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly breaks distance record.

verifications.claim: Artemis II serves as a test to prepare for Artemis III.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "ahead of sustained lunar exploration in future Artemis missions" specifically III landing (R3); "preparing for Artemis III" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated.

verifications.claim: Artemis II serves as a test to prepare for Artemis IV.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.evidence: No relevant content found
verifications.reasoning: Sources specify preparation for Artemis III; no mention of IV.

verifications.claim: Artemis II serves as a test to prepare for future missions.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "lay the groundwork for future exploration" (R1); "ahead of... future Artemis missions" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Broadly supported.

verifications.claim: Artemis III will land humans back on the lunar surface.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Artemis III → [aimed at] returning humans to the lunar surface" (R3); "Artemis III... land astronauts on the Moon" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Standard NASA plan confirmed.

verifications.claim: Artemis IV will land humans back on the lunar surface.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: Artemis III landing (R3); R9 outlier says IV but contradicts standard (R3 primary source)
verifications.reasoning: Official sources assign landing to III, not IV; R9 inconsistent.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Commander Reid Wiseman.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "commander Reid Wiseman" (all)
verifications.reasoning: Consistently listed.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Pilot Victor Glover.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "pilot Victor Glover" (all)
verifications.reasoning: Consistently listed.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Mission Specialist Christina Koch.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "mission specialist Christina Koch" (all)
verifications.reasoning: Consistently listed.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Mission Specialist Jeremy Hansen.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "mission specialist Jeremy Hansen" (all)
verifications.reasoning: Consistently listed.
